success.description: I You recite from the Book of Grudges, naming each unresolved grudge suffered by the dwarf people § by your clan, hold, and the whole. You and your dwarfallies who can hear you speak gain either the Energised, Inspired, or Invigorated condition for 2 rounds. If appropriate, you may also influence dwarfs who hear you speak.

boon.description: The condition granted by this card lasts for 3 rounds instead.

bane.description: Increase Party Tension by 1 and be more cautious about which Grudges you bring up.

sigmarsComet.description: So fierce is your rhetoric that you may grant all 3 conditions.

success.description: 4 You read off a litany of the Grudges perpetrated against your clan, your hold, and you personally by the target, his people; or people vaguely similar to the target. Influence the target, if appropriate, and he gains the Cowed or Rattled condition for 2 rounds (your choice).

boon.description: The condition granted by this card lasts for 3 rounds instead.

bane.description: Increase Party Tension by 1 and be more cautious about which Grudges you bring up in the future.

sigmarsComet.description: So fierce is your rhetoric that you may grant both conditions.

reckless.requirements: Dwarf only. Target must be able to hear and understand you.
